profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Northwestern Mutual
profile.summary: Developer that's passionate about helping organizations bridge the gap between business and technology in order to meet their goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer II / DevOps
positions.description:
-    In addition to my responsibilities as a Developer, I wear another hat as a Certified NM DevOps Engineer and serve as the primary contact on my team. 

-    I am entrusted with the full spectrum of DevOps duties underscoring my versatility and dedication.

- Implemented a versatile and robust data driven eSignature implementation for our new Digital Application Platform and is a key feature in the digital platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
-    I'm a key member of an inventive team leading the charge in creating a unique digital platform solution. This platform is devised to effortlessly orchestrate the digital life insurance application processes for a diverse range of products across the company, achieving a notable degree of automation with minimal human intervention. 

-    Our innovative strategies are modernizing the company's approach to managing digital products, greatly improving the experience for our field representatives and clients.

-    React/Redux, MikroORM, Node, Nest, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform,  Cucumber, Kafka, Git, AWS

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the downstream system team that orchestrates, assembles, and delivers excellent Life Insurance applications via mail or Digitally. Our teams main responsibility is to automate, and deliver a perfect client experience.

positions.title: Founder & Engineer
positions.description: A platform that enables food trucks to create their online storefront & be discovered in real time.
